lead.title: RTX 50-series GPU prices spike up to 41% as Blackwell memory costs bite
lead.summary: Tom's Hardware's Newegg median-price tracker shows RTX 50-series cards jumped from June to August: the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB is up 39%, the RTX 5070 up 36%, and the RTX 5090's US median climbed to $4,699.99. Rising GDDR7 memory costs are pushing consumer GPU prices far above MSRP, directly hitting anyone buying cards for a local inference rig.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek V4-Pro goes GA with MIT open weights
top_stories.summary: DeepSeek V4-Pro, the strongest open-weight value model (1.6T/49B active), was promoted to general availability with MIT weights on Hugging Face; community GGUF quants appeared within hours.

top_stories.title: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B: first open-weights agentic model that fits on one GPU
top_stories.summary: Meta's first Muse-family open-weights release: a ~30B dense multimodal agentic model whose 4-bit quant sits under 20 GB, shipping BF16, GGUF and ExecuTorch builds for a 24/32 GB VRAM envelope.

top_stories.title: Qwen3.8-Max (2.4T-A95B) open weights land on Hugging Face
top_stories.summary: Alibaba's first Max-class model released as open weights: a 2.4T MoE / A95B FP8 checkpoint, text-only under a revenue-share license and aimed at rack-scale deployment.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek nears $7.4B round at $74B valuation ahead of a 2027 IPO
top_stories.summary: DeepSeek is nearing a roughly $7.4B funding round valuing the Hangzhou lab at about $74B, expected to close by end of August ahead of a possible Shanghai Star Market IPO.

items.title: Layer bit-width allocation tunes LLM quantization for latency under a quality budget
items.summary: Formulates quantization as latency-performance maximization under an allowable generation-quality degradation budget for Gemma-3-1B, directly targeting efficient local inference on small models.

items.title: DAMP: decay-aware mixed-precision recurrent-state quantization
items.summary: A decay-aware mixed-precision scheme for the fixed-size recurrent states in Gated DeltaNet and Kimi Delta Attention layers, cutting inference memory that would otherwise grow with sequence length.

items.title: VISTA: verifier-informed student-to-teacher adaptation for self-distillation
items.summary: Improves on-policy self-distillation by adapting the teacher distribution toward the student based on a verifier, refining distillation for small models trained locally on their own rollouts.

items.title: Quantization-triggered backdoors expose a validation-deployment gap in LLMs
items.summary: Shows post-training quantization can trigger backdoors when the full-precision source is evaluated but quantization is applied downstream, a security risk for small-model edge deployment.

items.title: llama.cpp b10715 fuses the DFlash encoder into the KV-cache decode path
items.summary: Eliminates a device-to-host round trip and a second graph build per token for encoder-based vision inputs, released with WebGPU and Vulkan tuning builds (b10713/b10714).

items.title: Open WebUI v0.11.2 adds richer terminal-file previews
items.summary: Word documents and slide decks generated in the terminal now render as finished documents with a clickable page-strip of numbered thumbnails, and the 'preview may differ' warning is removed.

items.title: Sonde: a local code graph for AI coding agents
items.summary: A tree-sitter based code-context engine that serves coding agents structural answers about a codebase within a token budget, exposing an MCP server to keep code analysis local.

items.title: Why distributed inference hasn't taken off for 1.5TB open-weight models
items.summary: A r/LocalLLaMA thread on GLM-5's 1.5TB BF16 size examines why pooled consumer-GPU inference (Petals, Gensyn, llama.cpp RPC) hasn't become mainstream, citing node-level privacy, WAN latency and marginal speedups.

items.title: n8n community node plugs a free Pollinations AI chat model into Agent nodes
items.summary: A self-hoster's community node wires the Pollinations AI chat model into n8n's AI Agent and Chain nodes, giving users a free path to experiment with AI workflows before paying a provider.
